t: A small Linux camera from M5Stack with built-in face and object detection.
steps: Buy the UnitV2 from the M5Stack store, RobotShop, or The Pi Hut.
Install the SR9900 network driver from M5Stack on Windows or macOS.
Plug the camera into the computer with the USB-C cable.
Open Chrome and go to the address listed in the M5Stack docs.
Pick face detection in the built-in web page and wave at the camera.
Try color tracking and barcode reading next.
Open Jupyter Notebook on the camera and run a first OpenCV example.
meta: Open Board. From $52. A few stores.
